raw_segments.text: Precisely, was the answer. And Comacela, she charmed my English gold out of my British
British's pocket. I have been green, too, Miss Eyre. I grass green. Not a more vernal
tint freshens you now than once freshened me. My spring is gone, however, but it has
left me that French flower-ed on my hands, which in some moods I would fain be rid of.
Not valuing now the root whence it sprang. Having found that it was of a sort which nothing
but gold dust could manure, I have but half a liking to the blossom, especially when it
looks so artificial as just now. I keep it, and rear it rather, on the Roman Catholic
principle of expiating numerous sins, great or small, by one good work. I'll explain
all this some day. Good night.
